label: Bible Study
prompt: For God sent not his Son into the world to _____ the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verse: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
note: The verse right after John 3:16 — the mission was rescue, not condemnation.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: One man of you shall chase a _____: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.
verse: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.
note: Joshua's farewell math: one of you chases a thousand when the LORD is the one doing the fighting.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Josiah was _____ years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
verse: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
note: Josiah became king at eight years old — and grew up to lead one of Judah's greatest revivals.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the _____ of my fathers unto thee.
verse: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
note: Naboth wouldn't sell his family vineyard to King Ahab — the Law forbade it, and Jezebel had him framed.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Righteousness _____ a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
verse: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
note: A civics lecture in one line: righteousness 'exalteth' a nation, but sin is a reproach to any people.
